scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0132; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘Yes. The pay is good.’ and ‘The pay is good there too.’ are grammatical, natural uses of pay as remuneration; review sentence ‘This work takes a day.’ is also natural.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian copy consistently maps noun pay to «حقوق», distinguishes the verb sense, and gives a clear Persian cue for the legacy work/day review.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: The pay target is recognized, exposed in guided dialogue before dependent listening, transferred to a second workplace, retrieved from meaning, then followed by a separate low-stakes legacy review.

distractorQuality.evidence: A04, A05, and A07 use grammatical, natural distractors with explicit model audits and lesson-specific Persian contrast reasons.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: مایا و الکس در مرکز آموزشی درباره دو کار پاره‌وقت روی تابلو اعلانات حرف می‌زنند.

difficultyFit.evidence: The work/pay topic uses short copular sentences; only pay is a new scored target while know, make, work, and day are marked review.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: pay recurs across recognition, guided speech, listening, transfer, and hidden retrieval; a separate review task recombines older vocabulary without redefining it.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner evaluates pay in a second workplace while preserving the remuneration sense; A07 separately recombines legacy work and day.

overallCoherence.evidence: Outcome, scenario, target construction, learner turns, final retrieval, and backlog review all align to a workplace theme without adding unsupported context.

learnerExperience.evidence: Dependency ordering and source availability were audited, but no real learner test is claimed; perceived relevance and difficulty remain unverified.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image/photo/visual is claimed. A03 listens only to audio-required T01/T02 after A02 exposes that exchange; other tasks do not claim unavailable media.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only the bounded noun sense of pay meaning remuneration is reviewed as new material.
Legacy items know, make, work, and day are metadata-backed review items; A07 directly recombines work/day, while know/make are backlog reactivation markers rather than newly assessed targets.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: English grammar, noun/verb sense consistency, accepted speech strings, and every English distractor were checked.
Persian orthography and English–Persian meaning consistency were checked.
Target and review reference keys, parts of speech, sense keys, and provisional spec hash were cross-checked against canonical legacy Lessons and the worker packet.
Four unique legacy backlog items introduced in Lessons 40–84 are explicitly marked role=review, satisfying review-recombination intent without pretending they are new targets.
Learner-context dependency order was checked: A02 exposes T01–T04 before A03 uses T01/T02, and A06 retrieves an already exposed T04 response.
No unsupported visual claim exists; all listening sources are audio-required turns.
Final retrieval keeps the answer hidden before attempt.
Classmates story arc returns after 5 Lessons with the learner role switched.
